ambient_events: The stove is fed one stick and the door shut quietly.
A curtain is pulled round a bed by somebody who doesn't look in first.
Somebody very small is being talked to, at length, about nothing.
A name goes up on one of the small shelves. Chalk, not paint, and nobody remarks on why.
description:
Warm, and quiet, and much bigger inside than the door suggests. Beds along one wall with curtains that pull round, a stove, a rocking chair worn smooth, and a wall of small shelves each with a name chalked on it.

The name of this room isn't a joke and nobody here has ever heard it as one.

A great many things go wrong in this town that wouldn't go wrong in a city, and everyone knows the numbers, and the numbers are written on the wall by the door in the same hand as the rota, with no comment attached. Under them, in a different hand, is a much longer list of the ones who came through, and it's very much the longer list, and somebody has underlined that.
name: The Whelping Room
